name: Lantern Grove
tagline: The operating system for the modern independent funeral home.
positioning: Lantern Grove unifies arrangements, case files, and family aftercare into one calm system built for owner-operators, not conglomerates.

hero.h1: Every farewell deserves a flawless first call.
hero.sub: Lantern Grove turns the 2am first call, the arrangement conference, and the twelve-month aftercare follow-up into one graceful workflow — so your firm feels ten times its size.

features.title: Arrangement conferences, guided
features.description: Walk families through service, merchandise, and pricing on a live tablet. Selections flow straight into the GPL-compliant contract — no re-keying, no math errors.

features.title: Case files that never fumble
features.description: Every death certificate, permit, embalming log, and vendor confirmation lives in one timeline. See exactly what's outstanding before the family asks.

features.title: Obituaries in minutes
features.description: Draft, proof, and publish to your site and partner papers from one editor. Families approve with a tap instead of three emails and a fax.

features.title: Family portal & aftercare
features.description: Give each family a private hub for documents, payments, and grief resources — then trigger anniversary and estate-check follow-ups automatically.

features.title: Inventory that reconciles itself
features.description: Track caskets, urns, and vault stock in real time. Lantern Grove flags reorder points before your showroom floor goes bare.

features.title: Owner dashboards
features.description: See call volume, at-need vs. preneed mix, and outstanding receivables across every chapel from a single moody, glanceable screen.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose an hour after every arrangement re-typing the same names into six systems. Lantern Grove killed the duplicate work in a week. My directors go home on time now.
testimonials.name: Marta Vidal

testimonials.quote: The family portal alone justified the switch. Grieving families stop calling to ask 'is the permit done' because they can just see it. That's dignity, delivered.
testimonials.name: Desmond Ackroyd

testimonials.quote: I run two locations with nine staff. For the first time I can see receivables and case status across both without driving over. It feels like I hired an operations manager.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For the single-location firm ready to retire the paper case folder.
For growing firms coordinating staff, vendors, and families at scale.
For multi-location groups and cemetery-combined operations.

homepage.footerBlurb: Lantern Grove is the calm, complete operating system for independent funeral homes. Built for owner-operators who refuse to be outrun by the conglomerates.
